params.cc_m1_8: peak-exit certificate reported beside every phase-close certificate (CC-M1-8.1), on the SEATED entries of both DPs
params.ceil: one-position phase-close DP over entries at ANY SANE second; entry superset = 1-tick ZigZag spine UNION per-phase-block extremum landmarks (argmin/argmax of the block, and of the block minus its first SANE second); proven complete, brute-forced
params.ceil_prune: items grouped by exit second; per group keep the best item for each distinct predecessor-exit constraint (lossless)
params.certificate: m0 §8 phase-close walled certificate; wall from m0 walls.json ($900 cap), session-scoped cost_rt from census_a_cost.tsv phase=ALL
params.exit_forfeit: the best candidate's phase close lands before the leg end; $ = its leg-end-exit value minus its phase-close value
params.forfeit: FORFEIT = max(0, CEIL - ROSTER); greedy attribution order MISSED -> LATE -> EXIT_FORFEIT -> OCCUPANCY(remainder)
params.late: every same-side candidate at leg progress > 0.25; $ = phase-close value entering at the leg start minus the value of the FIRST candidate
params.leg_top_k: NONE — every leg >= $500 (§11.A), not the m0 top-2
params.missed: leg with zero same-side candidate in [leg_start, leg_end]; $ = the leg's CEIL-realisable phase-close value
params.oracle: ZigZag 0.25 x ATR14_{d-1}($) ANCHORED (c_d_recall.oracle_legs) on SANE mids (D-054 b7_sane mask)
params.progress: (dec_sec - leg_start_sec) / (leg_end_sec - leg_start_sec); decile = min(9, floor(10 x progress))
params.seal: m0 substrate is 2021-2025; 2026 never decoded (§0 seal)
params.strata: (calendar year x offer quartile) per asset; offer = SANE mid range ($); the cell's MEDIAN-offer session is picked — deterministic by construction (seed 20260814 declared, unused)
params.wall_arithmetic: float32, matching the m0 path-skeleton records the roster certificates are answered from (defect GA-1)
